subject: gk
question: Gita Gopinath is the first Indian-American woman to become Chief Economist at which of the following organisations?

options.text: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gita Gopinath is the First Deputy Managing Director of IMF.**
 
• She earlier held the post of Chief Economist from 2019 to 2022.
 
• She was the first Indian-American woman to become the Chief Economist at the IMF.
 
• She completed her graduation from the University of Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IMF - International Monetary Fund**

 
 
• International financial institution that oversees the stability of the monetary system.
 
• Headquarters: **Washington, D.C., US**
 
• DIrector-General: **Kristalina Gerogieva**
 
• Deputy MD: **Gita Gopinath**
 
 
 
• **IBRD - ****International Bank for Reconstruction and Development** 
 
 
• It is a part of World bank group
 
• It is a **developmental Bank** that gives **loans to developing countries**.
 
• Headquarters: **Washington DC, USA**
 
• Director-General: **David Malpass**
 
• MD & CFO: **Anshula Kant**
 
 
 
• **Forbes India**
 
 
• It is a **business magazine in India**.
 
• It is an Indian edition of the Forbes magazine (American magazine).
 
 
 
• **Deutsche Bank**
 
 
• It is a **German multinational financial institution**.
 
• It is the **largest banking institution in Germany**.
 
• It provides services like investment banking, asset management and private banking.
 
• Headquarters: **Frankfurt**
